verification.note: GitHub Actions run 31644062887 is green for both the expanded v1.16.1 targeted contracts and the full maintained regression suite. Runtime manifest validation rejects importable packages before payload download unless root LICENSE.txt and SOURCES.txt are declared with checksums, and also rejects metadata/description/cover/rights-only packages that contain no actual book file or graphic chapter/page payload. The existing library importer still performs deeper rights and content validation after download. Same-package imports remain serialized and refresh local import history after lock acquisition while reusing task-local remote inventory. Two real final book archives were also located in the project owner's file library and are being normalized for source-repository import; live Bothost/Telegram/VK/payment checks remain pending deployment.
